invariants.name: Fund Safety & LOCKED_BALANCE Conservation
invariants.property: LOCKED_BALANCE is non-negative and emergency_withdraw is strictly blocked from extracting locked user funds (escrows, streams, proposal deposits). LOCKED_BALANCE returns to 0 on full lifecycle.

invariants.name: Refund Path Integrity & Authorization
invariants.property: Refund requester must be payer or payee; refund amount cannot exceed original payment; asset must match; double processing is rejected.

invariants.name: Escrow Single-Release Guarantee
invariants.property: Escrow payout occurs at most once. Double release by owner, double release by arbiter, or claim-after-release fail with EscrowAlreadyReleased.

invariants.name: Stream Bounded Linear Vesting
invariants.property: Claims before start fail. Partial claims strictly bounded by linear vesting formula. Total claimed across lifetime <= total_amount. Cancellation strictly conserves claimed + refunded == total.

invariants.name: Pause Guard Isolation
invariants.property: Emergency pause blocks all 15 mutating entrypoints with ContractPaused. Read-only getters remain available. Unpause restores mutation safely.

invariants.name: Governance Single Vote Per Address
invariants.property: Each address can vote at most once per proposal. Duplicate votes are strictly rejected with AlreadyVoted.

models.name: Composite Deposit and Locked Balance Conservation
